details: Vulnerability in the Installed Base product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Data Provider UI).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Installed Base.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Installed Base accessible data as well as  unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of Installed Base accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.1 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N).
